title: Morocco Formally Denies Involvement in Deadly Ceuta Migrant Rush
detail: Morocco formally denied any involvement in the deadly mass migrant rush into Ceuta, calling allegations baseless as Spain and the EU continued their post-crisis response. The denial came as pressure mounted on Rabat over whether Moroccan border authorities had deliberately allowed or facilitated the crossing.

title: Spain's CNI Intelligence Agency Had Warned of Mass Crossings Into Ceuta Before Crisis
detail: Spain's intelligence agency CNI had warned of imminent mass crossings into Ceuta before the border crisis erupted, raising questions about whether Spanish authorities acted on the intelligence in time. The revelation adds scrutiny to the government's handling of the crisis and its coordination between intelligence and border security services.
